**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties, or early-termination/minimum fees on us as Licensee:

- **Fees (Art. V, VII)** are purely usage-based — initial payment, per-US$1m volume-band rates, $2,500/month support, and 33% Supplemental Payments — with no minimum volume commitment or shortfall charge, and no default-interest or late-payment penalty.
- **Effect of Termination (Art. XXI, p0138)** requires only return of the Licensed Technology and Confidential Information; no accelerated or make-whole payment.
- **Art. XXIII (p0142)** expressly bars termination damages of any kind against either party.
- The **audit cost-shift (p0064)** on a >5% discrepancy is reimbursement of actual audit cost, not a stipulated penalty.

This sits at the preferred position, so no edit is warranted under rule LD.
